newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wrightson moves into forestry services.
newsitem.headline: Wrightson moves into forestry services.

text.p: New Zealand rural services group Wrightson Ltd said on Tuesday it had taken a significant step into forestry services with the acquisition of two South Island forestry management and consulting businesses.
"Aorangi Forest Services and Pine Plan NZ, both well established as owner-operated businesses, have joined a new forestry services business within the Wrightson group," Wrightson said.

"Forestry offers substantial growth opportunities for Wrightson, reflecting our strategies for business expansion across more land uses and adding to the company's traditional focus on sheep, beef and arable farming," Chief Executive Greg Kay said.

The two newly-acquired companies plan, arrange and supervise forest development, manage forestry operations and provide consultancy advice to clients including farmers, forestry investment groups, local authorities and government agencies.
